example.title: Walk-up taco stand with a reclaimed-timber parapet

brief: A 2010s walk-up taco stand on the coast highway: a tiny white-painted single-storey block topped by a tall parapet of vertical reclaimed timber boards, black canvas awnings over an 'Order Here' window and a chalkboard menu, window boxes of flowers, black iron rail and high tables on the sidewalk. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
